m: उज्झ् cl. 6. P. उज्झति, उज्झां चकार, औज्झीत्, उज्झितुम्, &c. (probably a contraction from उद्- √ 2. हा [-जहाति]) to leave, abandon, quit, Ragh.; Pañcat.; MBh. &c.; to avoid, escape, Ragh.; Śiś.; to emit, discharge, let out.
a: उज्झ् — {c6c} P. [उज्झति, उज्झांचकार, उज्झितुं, उज्झित] 1 To abandon, leave, quit; सपदि विगतनिद्रस्तल्पमुज्झांचकार R. 5. 75; तत्क्षणोज्झतवृक्षकं R. 1. 40, 51; आतपायोज्झितं धान्यं Mb. exposed to the sun. --2 To avoid, escape from; उदये मदवाच्यमुज्झता R. 8. 84; Śi. 1. 63. --3 To emit, give out, drop or pour down; अविरतोज्झितवारिविपांडुभिः Ki. 5. 6; Śi. 4. 63.

s: Sa tyAge । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (tudAM -paraMsakaM -sew .) jopaDa ityeke । ujijJizati । OjijJat । Sa ujJatI ujJantI । iti durgAdAsaH ॥ anyat udJaDAtO drazwavyam ॥
puM, (ujJatIti । ujJa + ac .) tyAgaH । visarjanam । (yaTA, manuH 11 । 56 । “brahmojJatA vedanindA kOwasAkzyaM suhfdbaDaH” ॥)

tri॰ ujJati ujJa--ac । tyAgini । “brahmojJatA vedanindA kOwasAkzyaM suhfdbaDaH । garhitAnnAdyayorjagDiH surApARasamAni zaw” manuH ।
m: उज्झ mfn. quitting, abandoning, Mn.
a: उज्झ — a. [उज्झ्-अच्] Leaving, quitting.

m: उज्झक m. a cloud
a devotee, L.
a: उज्झकः — 1 A cloud. --2 A devotee.

m: उज्झन n. removing Comm. on Yājñ.
abandoning, leaving, HYog.
a: उज्झनं — [उज्झ्-ल्युट्] Abandoning, removing, leaving.

m: उज्झट-डिम्ब and उज्झटित vv.ll. for उज्जूट-डिम्ब and उज्जूटित, qq.v.
उज्-झटित mfn. disturbed, confounded, Rājat.
a: उज्झटित — a. Perplexed, bewildered, confounded.

s: tri, (ujJa + kta .) utsfzwam । tyaktam । varjitaM । iti halAyuDaH ॥ (yaTA kirAte । 5 । 6 । “aviratojJitavArivipARquBiH” । “ujJitAyAstvayA nATa ! tadEva maraRaM varam” ॥ iti rAmAyaRe 2 । 30 । 20 ॥)
m: उज्झित mfn. left, abandoned
free from, MBh.; R.; Śak. &c.
left off, discontinued
emitted, discharged (as water), Kir. v, 6.
उज्झित-कर्णक mfn. destitute of earrings, Bcar.
उज्झित—वत् mfn. one who has emitted or discharged, Śiś. v, 36.
उज्झितृ mfn. one who leaves.
उज्झिति f. abandoning (the world), TāṇḍyaBr. xviii, 6, 10.
उज्-जागर mfn. excited, irritated, Kād.
उज्-√ जागृ (उद्-√ जागृ) P. (pf. -जगार, [?] Hcar. 140, 3) to pass (time) waking: Caus. -जागरयति, to awake, call up, Sāh.; to excite; to effect, cause, Kāvyād.
उज्जालुक m. N. of a place, MBh.

v: pu॰ utaNkamunerASramAntike samudrasaviDe maruBUmizu vAlukAmayadeSaBede । yatra hi maDuputro DunDurutaNkaprArTitena kuvalASvena vizRutejasA vfMhitavIryyeRa nipAtitaH tatkaTA yaTA BA॰ harivaM॰ 11 a॰ । “mamASramasamIpe vE samezu maruDanvasu । samudro vAlukApUrRa ujjAnaka iti SrutaH । devAnAmapyabaDyaSca mahAkAyo mahAbalaH । antarBUmigatastatra vAlukAntarhito mahAn । rAkzasasya maDoH putro DunDurnAma mahAsuraH । Sete lokavinASAya tapa AsTAya dAruRam” । ityupakramya tadbaDovarRRitastat kaTADunDumAraSabde darSayizyate 2 uttaradeSasTe'pi deSaBede “etaddvAraM mahArAja! mAnasasya prakASate” ityupakramya “eza ujjAnakInAma pAvakiryatra SAntavAn” BA॰ va॰ 130 a॰ deSaBeda uktaH ।
m: उज्-जानक m. N. of a Tīrtha, MBh.; Hariv.
a: उज्जानकः — N. of a province in the North.

s: klI, (ut, jasu hiMsAyAm । Ric BAve lyuw .) mAraRam । baDaH । ityamaraH ॥
v: na॰ ud + jasa--Ric--lyuw । 1 mAraRe baDe etadyoge karmmaRaH saMbanDatvavivakzayA zazWI pratipadavihitatayA ca tayA zazWyA na samAsaH “cOrasyojjAsanam” si॰ kO॰ । “pratipadavihitA zazWI na samasyate” vArtti॰ । “proktA pratipadA zazWI samAsasya nivfttaye” Barttf॰ taTEvoktam
m: उज्-जासन n. killing, slaughter, L.
a: उज्जासनं — Killing, slaughter; चोरस्योज्जासनं Sk.

m: उज्-√ जीव् (उद्-√ जीव्) P. -जीवति, to revive, return to life, Bhaṭṭ.; MBh. : Caus. P. -जीवयति, to restore to life, animate Comm. on Kum.
a: उज्जीव् — {c1c} P. To revive, return to life. --Caus. To restore life.
उज्जीवनं — Revival.

m: उज्-जीविन् m. N. of a counsellor of Meghavarṇa (king of the crows), Pañcat.
a: उज्जीविन् — Reviving, coming to life again.

m: उज्-जीवित-मदालस N. of a drama.
उज्जूट-डिम्ब n. N. of a place, Rājat. (v.l. उज्झट˚).
उज्-जूटित mfn. one who wears the hair twisted together and coiled upwards, Rājat.

उज्-√ जन् (उद्-√ जन्), only, RV. : P. (pf. -जजान, iii, 1, 12) to beget, produce : Ā. (impf. 3. pl. उद्-अजायन्त, iv, 18, 1; aor. -अजनि, i, 74, 3; precative of the aor. -जनिषीष्ट, vii, 8, 6) to be born or produced, originate.
उज्-√ जस् (उद्-√ जस्), Caus. P. -जासयति, to destroy, extirpate, kill (with gen. Pāṇ. ii, 3, 56), Bhaṭṭ.; Śiś.
a: उज्जस् — Caus. To kill, destroy, extirpate (with gen.); बिडौजसोज्जासयितुं जगद्द्रुहां Śi. 1. 37.

s: strI, viSAlAnagarI । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ ujEna iti paScimadeSe KyAtA । vaNgadeSe tu ujanI । iyaM mAlavadeSasya nagarI । mokzadasaptapuryyantargatapurI । purA vikramAdityarAjaDAnI ca aDunA mahArAzwreRADikftA ॥ (yaTA, meGadUte pUrvvameDe । 29 ॥ “sODotsaNgapraRayavimuKo mA ca BUrujjayinyAH” .)
v: strI vikramAdityarAjaDAnyAm avantIpuryyAm avantISabde vivftiH । “sODotsasaNgapraRayavimuKo mAsmaBUrujjayinyAH” meGadU॰ । iyaYca laNkAvaDimeruparyyantasamareKAsTapurImaDye'nanyatamA yaTAha SropatiH “laNkA kumArI nagarI ca kAYcI pAnAwamadriSca sitaH zaqAsyaH । SrIvatsanulmaM ca purI tataSca mAhizmatI cojjayinI prasidDA । syAdASramo'smAnnagaraM suramyaM tataH puraM pawwaSivABiDAnam । SrIMgargarAwaM ca sarohitAKyaM sTAneSvaraM SItagiriH sumeruH । itIva yAmyottaragAM DarAyA reKAmimAM golavido vadanti । anyAni reKAsTitiBAYji loke jYeyAni tajjYEH puwaBedanAni” । sU॰ si॰ tu sAmAnyenoktam yaTA “rAkzasAlayadevOkaHSElayormaDyasUtragAH । rohItakamavantI ca taTA sannihitaM saraH” । “rAkzasAlayo laNkA devAnAM gfharUpaH parvato meruranayomaDye fjusUtraM tatra sTitA deSA raKyAKyA! । laNkAdakziRasUtrasTAstvanupayuktAstatra manuzyAgocaratvAditi noktAH । jYAnArTamudAharati । rohItakamiti । yaTA rohItakaM nagaramavantyujjayinI sannihitaM saraH kurukzetram । cakArastaTetyavyayaparaH । taTAnyAni parasparaM sannihitatayA jYeyAni” ra॰ mA॰ । “yaTojjayinyA kucaturTamAge prAcyAM diSi svAdyamakowireva” sU॰ si॰ ।
m: उज्-जयनी f. Ujjayinī (see below) or Oujein.
a: उज्जय(यि)नी — N. of a city, the modern Oujein in Mālvā, the capital of Vikramāditya. It is one of the seven sacred cities of the Hindus (cf. अवंति), and the first meridian of their geographers from which they calculate longitude; सौधोत्संगप्रणयविमुखो मा स्म भूरुज्जयिन्याः Me. 27.

m: उज्-जयन &c. See उज्-जि, col. 3.
उज्-जयन m. N. of a man, MBh.
उज्-जयन्त m. N. of a mountain in Surāṣṭra (in the west of India, part of the Vindhya range), MBh.
(see रैवत.)

s: strI, ujjayanInagarI । tatparyyAMyaH । viSAlA 2 avantI 3 puzkakaraRqinI 4 । iti hemacandraH ॥
m: उज्-जयिनी f. the city Oujein (the Gk. Ὀζήνη, a city so called in Avanti or Mālava, formerly the capital of Vikramāditya; it is one of the seven sacred cities of the Hindūs, and the first meridian of their geographers, from which they calculate longitude; the modern Oujein is about a mile south of the ancient city), Hit.; Megh.; Rājat. &c.
उज्जेन्द्र m. N. of a man, Rājat.

v: pu॰ udA + jiza--gatyAm BAve GaY । 1 utkarzaprAptO ujjiti Sabde udA॰ । ac । 2 utkfzwe tri॰ ।
m: उज्-जेष mf(आ)n. victorious, AV. iv, 17, 1 (voc. fem. उज्-जेषे), ŚBr.
a: उज्जेष — a. Victorious. --षः Obtaining prosperity.

m: उज्-जेष—वत् (उज्-जेष-), mfn. containing the word उज्जेष, ŚBr.

v: tri॰ ud + jiza--gatyAM Rini striyAM NIp । utkarza prApte “krIqI ca SAkI cojjezI” yaju॰ 17, 85 “ujjezI utkfzwajayanaSIlaH” vedadI॰ ।
m: उज्जेषिन् m. N. of one of the seven Maruts, VS. xvii, 85.

a: उज्जृंभ् — {c1c} A. 1 To gape, open. --2 To part asunder. --3 To become visible, come or break forth, expand, rise, go up; वक्त्रेंदौ तव सत्ययं यदपरः शीतांशुरुज्जृंभते Ratn. 3. 13; K. 290 --4 To revive, come to senses; Mv. 6. 52. --Caus. 1 To display, show. --2 To produce; U. 5. 6.
उज्जृंभा, --भणं — 1 The act of gaping, opening the mouth, yawning, --2 Spreading, increase; Māl. 5. 23. --3 Flurry, agitation; U. 3. 36.
उज्जृंभ — a. 1 Blown, expanded; उज्जृंभवदनांभोजा भिनत्यंगानि सांगना S. D. --2 Gaping, open. --भः 1 Opening, expansion, blowing. --2 Gaping of the mouth. --3 Breaking asunder, parting.
उज्जृंभित — a. Opened, stretched, expanded, blown. --तं 1 The act of gaping. --2 Effort, exertion.

m: उज्-√ जृम्भ् (उद्-√ जृम्भ्) Ā. -जृम्भते, to gape; to open, part asunder, BhP.; to show one's self, become visible, come forth, break forth, expand, arise, Prab.; Naiṣ.; Dhūrtas.

m: उज्-जृम्भ mfn. gaping, Sāh.
parting asunder, open, apart
blown, expanded, L.
उज्-जृम्भणा f. coming forth, arising, Bālar.

v: na॰ ud + juBi--BAve lyuw । vikASe muKavikASanaBede vyApAre (hAitolA) । “udgArakASakzavaTuzWIvanojjfmBaRAni ca” suSrutaH । ud + jfBi--a । ujjfmBA'pyatra strI ।
m: उज्-जृम्भण n. the act of gaping, opening the mouth, Suśr.
coming forth, arising, Bālar.

s: tri, (ut + jfmBi + kta ॥) praPullam । cezwAyAM, klI । iti medinI ॥
v: tri॰ ud + jfBi--kta । vikAsite । BAve kta । 2 cezwAyAm (hAitolA) 3 muKavyApAraBede na॰ ।
m: उज्-जृम्भित mfn. opened, stretched
expanded, blown
उज्-जृम्भित n. effort, exertion, L.

उज्-√ जि (उद्-√ जि) P. -जयति (pf. -जिगाय, &c.) to win, conquer, acquire by conquest, AV.; TS.; ŚBr.; TBr. &c.; to be victorious, AV.; TBr. : Caus. -जापयति, to assist any one to win; to cause to conquer (with two acc.), Kāṭh.; TāṇḍyaBr. &c.: Desid. -जिगीषति, to wish to conquer, ŚāṅkhŚr.
a: उज्जि — {c1c} P. 1 To win, acquire by conquest, conquer. --2 To be victorious, triumph. --Caus. (जापयति) 1 To cause to conquer. --2 To help one in winning.

m: उज्-जिघ्र mfn., Vop. 26, 34 (cf. जिघ्र, p. 421).
a: उज्जिघ्र — a. [उद्-घ्रा-श] Smelling.

m: उज्-जिगमिषा f. (fr. Desid. of √ गम्) desire of coming forth, Kāvyād.
उज्-जिहाना (आ), f. N. of a town, R. ii, 71, 12.
उज्-जिहान See 2. उद्-धा.
उज्-जिहान mfn. (pres. p. See above)
उज्-जिहान (आस्), m. pl. N. of a people, VarBṛS. xiv, 2
उज्-जिहान-जीवित mfn. one whose life is departing, about to die, Mālatīm.
उज्-जिहीर्षा f. (fr. Desid. of √ हृ with उद्), wishing to take or seize [see also 2. उद्धृ].
उज्-जिहीर्षु (fr. Desid. of उद् + √ हृ), wishing to extricate or rescue, MBh.

v: strI ud + ji--ktin । utkfzwajaye “agnIzomayorujritimanujjezam” yaju॰ 2, 25 । “ujjitimanu pahataviGnena haviHsvIkaraRarUpamutkfzwajayam” vedadI॰ । “somasyojjitimityagnirvanasyatiH” kAtyA॰ 10, 7, 14 । “ujjitiByo vottaro mAhendraH” kAtyA॰ 14, 5, 31 । agnIzomayorujjitimanUjjezam । “agnIzomayorujjitimanUjjayati” indrAgnyorujjitimanUjjayati” Sata॰ brA॰ 1, 8, 3, 1, 2, 3, 4 । 2 ujjayaliNgayuktamantrakaraRakAhutO ca । “aTojjitIH” ityupakramya “agnirekAkzareRa prARamujjayattamujjezam” ityAdi Sata॰ brA॰ 2, 2, 16, 17 uktam ।
m: उज्-जिति f. victory, VS.; TBr.; KātyŚr.
N. of the verses, VS. ix, 31 sqq. (so called because the words उदजयत् तम् उज्जेषम् occur in them), ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
a: उज्जितिः — f. Ved. 1 Victory. --2 N. of certain verses in the VājasaneyiSaṃhitā.

m: उज्-ज्वालन n. lighting up, Car.
उज्-√ ज्वल् (उद्-√ ज्वल्) P. -ज्वलति, -ज्वलिति (Pāṇ. vii, 2, 34), to blaze up, flame, shine, TS.; ŚBr.; R.; BhP. : Caus. P. : -ज्वलयति, to light up, cause to shine, illuminate, ŚBr.; Rājat.; Śiś. &c.
a: उज्ज्वल् — {c1c} P. To blaze up, shine. --Caus. (ज्वलयति) To light up, illuminate, irradiate; Śi. 9. 42; Gīt. 12.

m: उज्-ज्वला f. splendour, clearness, brightness
a form of the Jagatī metre.

s: tri, (uccErjvalati prakASate iti । ut + jval + ac .) dIptam । viSadam । vikASitam । iti medinI ॥ (yaTA, sAhityadarpaRe । 3 paricCedaH । “asmAkaM saKi ! vAsasI na rucire grEveyakaM nojjvalaM” । “vicitrojjvalaveSA tu balannUpuraniHsvanA” ॥)
klI, (ut + jvala + ac .) svarRam । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
puM, (ut + jvala + ac .) SfNgArarasaH । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, nEzaDe 1 । 1 । “sa rASirAsInmahasAM mahojjvalaH” ॥)
v: tri॰ ud + jvala--ac । 1 dIpte, 2 viSade, 3 vikASini ca । 4 SfNgArarase pu॰ । “sa rASirAsInmahasAM mahojjvalaH “SfNgAraBaNgyA mahAkAvyecAruRi nEzaDIyacarite sargonisargIjjvalaH” nEza॰ । “svAtantryamujjvalamavAva kareRu rAjaH” aviratamudDatimujjvalAM daDAnEH” mAGaH । “asmAkaM saKi! vAsasI na rucire grEveyakaM nojjvalam” sA॰ da॰ “vicitrojjvalaveSA tu valannupUranisvanAH” sA॰ da॰ “sumuKAH palvalojjvalAH” suSru॰ । asya ca rasAntaratvaM gosvAmigranTe sTitam । 5 svarRena॰ rAjani॰ DAtumaDye tasyAddIptotvAttaTAtvam । tasya BAvaH zyaY Ojjvalya tva । ujjvalatva tadBAve na॰ । tal । ujjvalatA strI tatrEva ।
m: उज्-ज्वल mfn. blazing up, luminous, splendid, light
burning
clean, clear
lovely, beautiful, Suśr.; MBh.; Kathās.; Sāh. &c.
glorious
full-blown, L.
expanded
उज्-ज्वल m. love, passion, L.
उज्-ज्वल n. gold, L.
a: उज्ज्वल — a. 1 Bright, shining, luminous, splendid; उज्ज्वलकपालं मुखं Śi. 9. 48, 47. --2 Burning. --3 Clean, clear, white; Śi. 6. 5. --4 Lovely, beautiful; सर्गो निसर्गोज्ज्वलः N. 3. 136. --5 Mixed with, seasoned; Mk. 8. 13. --6 Blown, expanded. --7 Unrestrained, full; Śi. 5. 48 --लः Love, passion. --ला 1 Splendour, brightness. --2 Clearness. --3 A form of the Jagatī metre. --लं Gold. --Comp. --दत्तः N. of the author of a commentary on the Uṇādi Sūtras.

k.v: शृङ्गारवीरकरुणाद्भुतहास्यभयानकाः। बीभत्सरौद्रौ च रसाः शृङ्गारः शुचिरुज्ज्वलः॥
